summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test for Mystery Box India. Backend pytest: 16/16 pass. Frontend Playwright: registration -> localStorage mb_token -> add to cart -> qty +/- and totals correct -> COD checkout (order persisted, amount 1598, status=placed, visible in /api/orders) -> Stripe checkout returns and redirects to checkout.stripe.com -> Subscription (?sub=premium) COD creates active subscription -> Guest redirected /account -> /login. The previously-flagged COD persistence issue is NOT reproducible: orders are being created and returned by GET /api/orders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True which is invalid per spec (browsers will refuse). Currently unused since auth switched to Bearer, but should be tightened to an explicit origin list or a real regex; cookie-based auth via set_auth_cookie will silently fail cross-origin.

seed_data() has no admin migration when ADMIN_PASSWORD env is unset -- default 'admin123' would overwrite production admin hash on startup. The Mongo record was already migrated by env-configured MysteryAdmin@2026, so admin login works, but this behaviour is risky.
STRIPE_API_KEY defaults to 'sk_test_emergent' if env missing -- would fail silently on card checkout with a confusing error; consider failing fast.

Checkout accepts arbitrary 'shipping' dict without server-side validation of name/phone/pincode -- COD with empty shipping succeeds (test_empty_cart_rejected only checks items). Recommend Pydantic model for shipping.
seed_data_creation: Registered ~3 disposable users of the form qa_<hex>@example.com and test_<hex>@example.com with COD orders + one active premium subscription each. Safe to leave.
test_credentials: Admin admin@mysterybox.in / MysteryAdmin@2026 verified working. New users created on the fly in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and frontend are healthy. All flows in the review_request pass. Only optional hardening items are the code-review comments above (CORS spec compliance, shipping validation, Stripe key fail-fast).
rca_of_the_issue: Prior manual test could not confirm COD order persistence. Root cause was the earlier cookie/CORS conflict; the current Bearer-token implementation (Authorization header attached by /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js interceptor from localStorage 'mb_token') works reliably. Verified by (a) placing a COD order via UI and reading /api/orders with the same token showing the order, and (b) pytest TestCheckout::test_cod_checkout_end_to_end which creates -> reads back.
